newsitem.title: USA: Data hint at strength in US consumption - Minehan.
newsitem.headline: Data hint at strength in US consumption - Minehan.

text.p: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Cathy Minehan said on Friday that initial first quarter retail and durable goods data suggest continued strength in consumption and business investment.

"The sketchy data we have on retail sales and durable goods orders for this quarter suggest continued strength both in consumption and business fixed investment," Minehan told a panel discussion on the economy at Middlebury College.
She noted that residential investment might also be "more resilient than we currently expect in our forecast."
